description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called InsuranceFragment, which displays static insurance information including policy coverage, claim procedures, and a claim button. It is designed to match a Kotlin InsuranceFragment and uses Flutter material components for UI layout.

classes.name: InsuranceFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders static insurance information in a scrollable view, including header, coverage details, claim procedure info, and a claim button.
